Call script: Hi {First}, this is {Agent} with Florida Luxury Realty. Thank you for answering my call. I'm a real estate broker and full time agent coach, and I work with agents every day to increase their production, sharpen their skills and build a stronger business. Does that sound like something you'd want for your business? [Listen.] That's exactly why I called. It would be worthwhile for us to sit down and compare notes, no obligation and no pressure. Would Monday or Tuesday work?

Voicemail if no answer: Hi {First}, this is {Agent}. I'm reaching out to connect with good agents in our area. No sales pitch, just sharing ideas on growing production. Call me back at {Phone}. Again, that's {Phone}.
First call to a licensed agent. Listen more than you talk. If they say no: it's common to say no, so doesn't it make sense to at least meet up and then make your own educated decision?
Hi {First}, {Agent} with Florida Luxury Realty. I just tried to reach you. I'm connecting with good agents in our market to share ideas on growing production. Open to a coffee next week?
Send right after the call attempt. Confirm texting consent rules first.

Hi {First}, I'm {Agent} with Florida Luxury Realty. I spend my days coaching agents on production and building systems that create predictable business. I'm not asking you to change anything. I'd like to buy you a coffee, compare notes and share what's working. Would a 20 minute meeting next Tuesday or Thursday work? You can reach me at {Phone}. – {Agent}

Call script: Hi {First}, this is {Agent}. Did I catch you at an okay time? I work with agents throughout the area, and many good agents are looking for more than the basics. They want ways to increase production, create leverage and build a stronger business. What's your biggest business challenge right now: more listings, more buyers, consistent lead generation or time management? [Listen.] If I could show you a few ideas that might help you close more transactions this year, would you be open to a brief meeting next week?
Second call attempt. If you reach them, set Status = Connected and fill When Could They Move. If no live contact after this call, set Status = Attempting.
Hi {First}, {Agent} with Florida Luxury Realty. I'd still like to connect. Quick question: what's the biggest thing holding your business back right now, leads, time or systems?
Re-open the conversation with one easy question.
Hi {First}, {Agent} here with Florida Luxury Realty. We're hosting a training session for local agents on [topic] on [date]. Want the details? No obligation.
Daily Action Plan item: Facebook message outside agents with a training invite. Fill in the topic and date before sending.

Voicemail: Hi {First}, this is {Agent}. I'm reaching out to connect with successful agents and share ideas on growing production and creating additional opportunities. No sales pitch. Call me back at {Phone}. Again, that's {Phone}. I look forward to speaking with you.
Hi {First}, I've reached out a few times and haven't connected, so I'll check in less often. If you ever want to compare notes on growing your production, reply anytime. – {Agent}
Last attempt. If no response, set Status = Not Now and When Could They Move = Unknown.

Hi {First}, this is {Agent}. Thanks for taking my call today. I'd enjoy connecting over coffee and sharing some ideas that are helping agents grow their business in today's market. Let me know what your schedule looks like next week.
Follow-up text after a connected call. Send the same day. This step does not repeat in the loop.

Hi {First}, thanks for the conversation. When we sit down I'd like to cover three things: where your business is today, where you want it to be, and what training, support and systems would get you there. Do Tuesday or Thursday work for 20 minutes? You can also reach me at {Phone}. – {Agent}
Hi {First}, our next Round Table for agents is [date and topic]. It's a working session you can use right away. Want to join as my guest? Link: [add]
Add the date, topic and link before sending. Invite agents who are not at FLR too.

Call script: Hi {First}, {Agent} checking in. On a scale of 1 to 10, how satisfied are you with the support, training, lead generation opportunities and overall growth you're getting right now? [If less than a 10:] What's keeping it from being a 10? [Listen.] I'd love to buy you a coffee or lunch and exchange ideas. Worst case, we make a new connection. Would next Tuesday or Thursday work for 20 minutes?
Book the coffee or lunch. When it's booked, set Status = Lunch/Meeting Set. The plan loops from step 2.
Hi {First}, looking forward to our meeting. Confirming [day, time, place]. I'll bring some ideas on production and what support could look like for your business. – {Agent}
Send as soon as the meeting is booked.
{First}, quick reminder about our meeting [today or tomorrow] at [time and place]. See you there. – {Agent}
Send the day before. If the meeting is several days out, move Last Touch Date forward so this comes due the day before.

Dear {First}, Just a quick thank you for giving me your valuable time and allowing me to share about Florida Luxury Realty with you. It would be an honor and privilege to be a partner with you in Florida. Please contact me for any outstanding questions you may have. Regards, {Agent}
Mail within a day of the meeting.

Call script: Hi {First}, {Agent}. Thanks again for meeting with me. What stood out to you? What questions came up? What would you need to see to feel good about a next step? [Listen, then book the next step.]
After the meeting, set Status = Considering.
Hi {First}, thank you for joining us at the Round Table. What was your biggest takeaway for your business? – {Agent}

Call script: Hi {First}, {Agent}. Thanks for joining us. What stood out to you? I'd love to hear what's working in your business and how we can support your next step. Can we grab coffee or lunch this week?
About day 3. Book the one on one.
Hi {First}, I'd enjoy sitting down one on one to look at your goals, your numbers and the support that would help you get there. Twenty minutes, no pressure. Does Tuesday or Thursday work? – {Agent}
About day 7. If they agree to meet, set Status = Lunch/Meeting Set. If no reply, set Status = Connected and fill When Could They Move.
Call script: Hi {First}, {Agent}. I wanted to check in. What questions can I answer for you? What would make this an easy decision? [Listen and write what you hear in Notes.]
{First}, checking in. Anything I can clarify on training, support, tools or how onboarding works? Happy to walk you through it. – {Agent}

Answer the concern you heard on the call. If they sign, set Status = Joined.
{First}, want to sit down for 20 minutes and map out what your first 90 days at FLR would look like? Then you can see it on paper. – {Agent}
Move toward a decision. The plan loops from step 1.

Hi {First}, just checking in. If growing production or adding leverage is on your list, I'm a resource: training sessions, ideas that are working for agents right now, no strings attached. Let me know where your business is today. – {Agent}
Stay visible. Re-qualify When Could They Move.
{First}, quick check-in from {Agent}. Is your timeline for a change the same, or has anything shifted?
If the timeline shortens, update When Could They Move and the plan changes.
Hi {First}, {Agent} with Florida Luxury Realty. We're hosting a training session for agents on [topic] on [date]. Want the details?
Fill in the topic and date before sending.

Hi {First}, here's a simple way to set your daily activity. Twelve closings a year takes about ten appointments a month, which takes about 100 conversations a month. That's roughly 5 real conversations a day. What's your closing goal for next year? I'm glad to help you work the math backward. – {Agent}
Value touch. The plan loops from step 1.
Hi {First}, I keep in touch with good agents even when the timing isn't right. If anything changes in your business or your plans, I'd welcome the conversation. – {Agent}

{First}, {Agent} with Florida Luxury Realty. We have a training session coming up on [topic and date]. Want an invite?
Fill in the topic and date before sending.

Hi {First}, this is a good time of year to set production goals. If it would help, I'll walk through a simple plan with you: your closings goal, the conversations it takes and the systems to support it. No obligation. – {Agent}
{First}, how's business going? I'd enjoy hearing what's working for you. – {Agent}
Relationship touch. The plan loops from step 1.
Hi {First}, with your {Trigger} coming up, this is a good time to look at your options before anything is urgent. Want to grab coffee and compare notes? No pressure. – {Agent}
About 60 days before the Trigger Date. Attorney review needed before any message refers to another brokerage's dates.
{First}, checking in ahead of your {Trigger}. Happy to talk through what to look for, whatever you decide.
Call script: Hi {First}, {Agent}. I know your {Trigger} is close. I'm not calling to pressure you. Would a 20 minute meeting this week help you compare notes before you decide anything? [Listen.]

Hi {First}, thinking of you as your date arrives. I'm here if you'd like to talk it through. – {Agent}
